text_block_list.text:
Today was Yaeno Muteki's dance training.
She approached it with great enthusiasm, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Seiyaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! I am so sorry!
I did it again...!"

Yaeno Muteki's dancing starts off well, but as she dances,
she somehow gets into an excited frenzy
and begins unleashing attacks.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I have no excuse... Dance and martial arts share common ground.
I thought it would be simple if I approached it
like performing a kata, but—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That is the trap! Straining myself too much,
before I knew it, phantoms of my rivals appeared before my eyes one after another...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... One more time!
Next time, I will surely master this raging fire within me!
choice_data_list: W-Wait, let's take a break for a second!

text_block_list.text:
"...This might quietly be a grave situation.
If her 'raging flame' goes completely out of control
during the live performance or something..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... Osupyoi!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Ah... That guy... wiped out everyone on stage in just a few seconds!
...It could very well end up like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it's because I put too much force into every single motion and let my bloodlust show.
They used to warn me about that a lot at the dojo, too...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "If only there were some clever way... to relax and focus solely on smooth, fluid movement...!"
choice_data_list: Let's increase the number of simulated opponents... a hundredfold!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
! I see! Pay no mind to attacking,
and just deflect everything continuously,
like a willow swaying in the wind...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
This is a teaching I can apply to martial arts training as well.
Thank you very much!
This should open the path forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! Then, milord Trainer,
I have a single favor to ask of you—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Feel free to strike at me
even in the middle of my dance!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With both illusions and the tangible presence of Trainer-dono attacking me, this training will surely be most effective!
Overcoming it shall serve as a great lesson!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now, do not hold back!
Come at me with all you have!

And so... though I was thoroughly exhausted,
Yaeno Muteki successfully mastered
movements that flowed like water.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
W-What...?
Wouldn't that just leave you with
even less leeway than before?
choice_data_list: However... what if we pushed them to the absolute limit?
Still... what if I push them past their limit until they lose all composure?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...! That's it! There's no room to face every single phantom with everything I've got—I naturally have no choice but to flow like water!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: An earth-shattering idea... As expected of you, Trainer! I shall put it into practice at once!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Mind... focus!

text_block_list.name: Phantom Hundred Legion
text_block_list.text: —Hehehe, foolish! To leap into the jaws of death yourself... Taste the true power of our Phantom Hundred!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Awakening 'Still Water'—
I shall handle... everything!"

"Whether facing 100 times the foes in her mind or not,
she performed a magnificent, flowing 'dance.'
...Yaeno Muteki's battle has only just begun!"
